item.title: Rescue teams search for 12 missing after deadly Nepal avalanche
item.description: An avalanche in northern Nepal has killed at least two people, and a search is underway for 12 others still missing.

item.title: Nor'easter weakens after deadly battering of Northeast
item.description: The nor'easter is weakening and drifting slowly northeast from Long Island, New York, to Massachusetts on Monday.

item.title: House Democrats plan oversight of Trump administration; impeachment an option
item.description: Democrats are preparing an agenda if the party sweeps control in November.

item.title: District attorney reopens case of alleged Cornell University 'gang rape'
item.description: Prosecutors in central New York say they are reopening the case of an alleged gang rape at a Cornell University fraternity.
